---
# Epicentre deck template (quarto-epi-deck). Replace every <...>, add the deck
# to the render list of _quarto.yml and its results prefixes to the project's
# registry of report dates, then delete these comments.
title: "<What the deck covers, without commas>"
subtitle: "<Data and scope, in one line>"
format:
  pptx:
    # The Epicentre template, its layouts renamed for pandoc
    # (templates/build_reference_pptx.py); path relative to this deck
    reference-doc: ../templates/epicentre_reference.pptx
    slide-level: 2
    monofont: Consolas
date: last-modified
date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  res_date: "latest"
  results_dir: "output/fits"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pacman::p_load(
  rio, here,
  tidyverse
)

# Summarises qmd/<topic>/<topic>.qmd; fits nothing and reads only the
# aggregate results of scripts/<topic>/<topic>.R. Text through showtext in
# the template's font
source(here("R", "report_tables.R"))
source(here("R", "report_figures.R"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.showtext = TRUE)
slide_font <- epi_font()

res_dir <- here(params$results_dir)
source(here("R", "report_dates.R"))
dates <- resolve_dates(params, res_dir, "<topic>_slides")
file <- file.path(res_dir, paste0("res_<topic>_", dates$res_date, ".rds"))
stopifnot("Run scripts/<topic>/<topic>.R first" = file.exists(file))
r <- import(file)
stopifnot(all(c("sources", "<element>") %in% names(r)))
data_label <- format(as.Date(dates$res_date), "%d %B %Y")

pct <- function(x) sub("-", "−", sprintf("%.0f%%", round(x) + 0), fixed = TRUE)
num <- function(x) scales::comma(x, accuracy = 1)
ci <- function(est, lo, hi) sprintf("%s (%s to %s)", pct(est), pct(lo), pct(hi))
one_row <- function(d, ...) {
  out <- filter(d, ...)
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == 1)
  out
}

# ggplot theme for slides
theme_slide <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = slide_font) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Tables drawn as images (pandoc's PowerPoint tables cannot be sized), in
# the template's font with the Epicentre header blue
slide_table <- function(dat, left = 1, size = 13) {
  dat <- mutate(dat, across(everything(), as.character))
  ft <- flextable::flextable(dat) |>
    flextable::font(fontname = slide_font, part = "all") |>
    flextable::fontsize(size = size, part = "all") |>
    flextable::bold(part = "header") |>
    flextable::color(color = "#2E569E", part = "header") |>
    flextable::align(j = seq_len(left), align = "left", part = "all") |>
    flextable::align(j = setdiff(seq_along(dat), seq_len(left)), align = "right", part = "all") |>
    flextable::border_remove() |>
    flextable::hline_top(border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E569E", width = 1.5), part = "all") |>
    flextable::hline_bottom(border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2E569E", width = 1.5), part = "body") |>
    flextable::autofit()
  plot(flextable::gen_grob(ft, fit = "auto", just = "center"))
}
```
